objective: Convert the already-front-loaded candidate supply into formal cross-circumference support with the smallest avoidable idle time while satisfying the frozen gate's rider, row, venue, calendar-block, concentration, and identity constraints. This plan does not count any candidate as support before the formal receipt chain passes.

portfolio_policy.primary: Acquire formal conversions, not more raw candidates, unless a documented gate-coverage deficit requires queue expansion.
event_selection_key: actual positive Day1 racecard before cutoff interrupts all lower-priority work
prefer events that add a missing or underrepresented circumference venue and frozen calendar block
prefer a new unique rider over another row for an already-supported rider until the 30-rider floor is secured
prefer earlier event start date when gate contribution is otherwise equivalent
prefer the choice that lowers projected single-venue and single-rider concentration
stable tie-breaker: venue, event date, official registration number
portfolio_policy.calendar_block_rule: Use only the frozen gate/evaluator definition. This portfolio does not invent or loosen calendar-block granularity.
portfolio_policy.concentration_rule: Never authorize a portfolio selection that would require exceeding venue 0.60 or rider 0.10 to pass the gate.
portfolio_policy.identity_rule: Official registration mapping must remain 1.0 for every supported row; ambiguous identity fails closed.
